title: Exotic Yeasty Australian Pineapple Bake
description: A sweet and crumbly Australian dessert featuring pineapple juice and shio-cure, wrapped in a ti-leaf for a unique presentation. This dish is perfect for special occasions and is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the pineapple juice, shio-cure, yeast, and sugar, stirring until the yeast is dissolved.
Add the flour, eggs, and melted butter to the bowl, mixing until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Wrap each ball in a ti-leaf, securing with a toothpick if necessary.
Place the wrapped dough balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the baked goods from the oven and let them cool for 10 minutes before serving.
